playstyle-desc-backrooms:
You noclipped out of reality.

Wake up in an endless maze of yellow rooms with nothing but the clothes on your back. Scavenge supply boxes for food and Almond Water, and find a way to survive.
worldattribute-backroomsMenace-desc: How much the things that live in the Backrooms trouble you. Off leaves only their sounds.
worldconfig-backroomsMenace-High: High (more often, harder hits, more of them hunt)
worldconfig-backroomsMenace-Veryhigh: Very high (often, hard hits, crowds hunt)
worldattribute-backroomsScarcity-desc: How much food and drink the Backrooms leave you: in boxes, crates, cupboards and fridges, in vending machines, water coolers and fountains and how soon they restock, in Level 10's livestock and, in new worlds, Level 9's gardens and Level 10's fields. Normal is scarce enough that scavenging matters.
worldconfig-backroomsScarcity-Scarce: Scarce (about a third of the food)
worldattribute-backroomsMap-desc: How much the map helps you find your way. Seen areas: the map fills in with what you have seen, and marks the ways between levels you took and the places notes tell of. No waypoints: the same map, but it marks nothing for you. None: no map or minimap at all; notes and chalk are all you have to go by, and chalk is a little easier to find.
worldattribute-backroomsLevelSize-desc: How wide the levels are: how far you go through each one before the next begins. Only the distance changes: rooms, halls and buildings are as big as ever, and the city and the other far places lie where they always do. Fixed when the world is made; changing it later does nothing.
